purpose: deterministic null/alternative distance filter before freezing a support-recovery Monte Carlo study
fixed_noise_calibration: coordinate standard deviations of original d=-1 trajectory at h=0.01; same covariance for every alternative
alternative_coefficient: d=-delta, all other coefficients and initial state fixed
scope: simple Gaussian hypotheses with fixed equal initial states; not composite-support recovery or a nuisance-adjusted finite-noise weak bound
